sources.label: NPS Paddle the Upper Current River
sources.supports: Identifies Pulltite as a popular Upper Current River put-in and documents the Pulltite-to-Round-Spring float time.
sources.doesNotSupport: Does not publish the exact water-entry coordinate.

sources.label: Current NPS Superintendent's Compendium and landing context
sources.supports: Identifies Pulltite as a Current River landing and lists flood-related closure markers.
sources.doesNotSupport: Does not publish a surveyed water-entry coordinate.

sources.label: Google Maps aerial imagery at the Pulltite landing
sources.supports: Visible County Road EE-356 approach and its connection to the Current River landing.
sources.doesNotSupport: Aerial imagery does not establish access permission independently or provide survey accuracy; NPS establishes public-site identity.

sources.label: USGS National Hydrography Dataset route-coordinate audit
sources.supports: Mapped-water proximity and matched named-flowline distance for the old and updated points.
sources.doesNotSupport: Mapped hydrography is not a survey of the ramp or carry path.

coordinateMethod: Aerial imagery estimate at the visible public Current River landing, checked against mapped-water geometry; approximately 75 ft uncertainty. Not surveyed.
